extraction: Exact downloaded bytes; no transformation. Create request selected for schema validation.

semanticEvidence.coverage: One-time credential, generated native ID, nonunique name, explicit scopes, default full access when scopes omitted and maximum 100 keys.
Native user_id identifies the exact account for reviewed management access.

Documented whitelabel.read, user.email.read and user.username.read names; GET /scopes returns the authenticating key’s scopes. Native sender-route success establishes actual read authority; alternate denied routes do not invalidate an independently verified exact sender.

Automatic sender verification and two-factor requirement flags; paired with pinned ApiKeyScopesResponse example for API-key readback. Only sender_verification_eligible, sender_verification_legacy and 2fa_required are accepted in addition to mail.send; no exemptions or other permissions.

nativeObservation.limits: Read-only projection from one existing key. Official optional result[] schema is permissive and does not constrain these direct-object fields; native identity semantics require independent checks. No native creation, deletion or delivery evidence.
